text: 【工信部财务司：深化产融合作 服务新型工业化】在今日举行的上海证券交易所国际投资者大会上，工业和信息化部财务司相关负责同志表示，“十四五”以来，已将产融合作纳入货币、信贷、资本市场等30多项政策中。截至目前，国家产融合作平台入库企业近46万家，接入金融机构3100多家、金融产品850余项，嵌入产业政策超50项，累计助企融资突破1.8万亿元，推动制造业企业融资纳入国家“高效办成一件事”重点事项。
text_en: [Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Department of Finance: Deepen industry-finance cooperation to serve new industrialization] At the Shanghai Stock Exchange Global Investors Conference held today, a relevant official of the MIIT Department of Finance stated that since the 14th Five-Year Plan, industry-finance cooperation has been incorporated into more than 30 policies covering monetary, credit, and capital markets. To date, nearly 460,000 enterprises have registered on the national industry-finance cooperation platform, which has connected more than 3,100 financial institutions and over 850 financial products and embedded more than 50 industrial policies, helping enterprises raise over 1.8 trillion yuan in total financing, and has included manufacturing enterprise financing as a key item in the national "efficiently completing one thing" initiative.
